description.value: Boston Pizza Big Bend is a full-service Canadian casual dining chain restaurant and sports bar located in the Big Bend area of Burnaby. Founded by a Greek immigrant in Edmonton in 1964, it is now Canada's largest casual dining brand with hundreds of locally owned franchise locations. The Big Bend location offers dine-in, takeout, and delivery with a broad menu spanning pizzas, pastas, wings, burgers, and more.
